verdict.rationale: Notte's stealth-mode docs say every session automatically gets clean, realistic browser fingerprints and built-in anti-bot features, and recommend combining stealth with residential proxies. The marketing site lists residential proxies on a global network, with fixed IPs and bring-your-own proxy support. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of geo-targeting or country selection and of how proxies are configured per session, plus independent or hands-on confirmation that stealth and proxies actually avoid bot blocking.
